content: .{@-आवर्तः@} [आर्याम् आवर्तन्ते अत्र] ‘abode of the noble or excellent (Āryas)’; particularly <ab>N.</ab> of the tract extending from the eastern to the western ocean, and bounded on the north and south by the Himālaya and Vindhya respectively; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 2. 22</ls>; आ समुद्रात्तु वै पूर्वादा समुद्राच्च पश्चिमात् . तयोरेवान्तरं गिर्योः (हिमवद्विन्ध्ययोः) आर्यावर्तं विदुर्बुधाः ..; also 10. 34.
